s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of upper gastrointestinal bleeding with epigastric pain
salient_findings: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration
key_facts: One-week history of epigastric pain and hematemesis
No significant medical or surgical history
Hemoglobin rose to 10 g/dL after transfusion
Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration of the overlying mucosa
Well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass measuring 6×5 cm with fat attenuation

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration of the overlying mucosa, consistent with GIST presentation

shortlist.label: Peptic ulcer disease
shortlist.why_kept: Epigastric pain and hematemesis, with a submucosal lesion and ulceration, could be indicative of a peptic ulcer

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass with fat attenuation, consistent with lipoma characteristics

shortlist.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although biopsy showed no malignant features, gastric adenocarcinoma remains a possibility given the patient's symptoms and mass location

shortlist.label: Dieulafoy's lesion
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of upper gastrointestinal bleeding with epigastric pain, which could be indicative of a Dieulafoy's lesion

raw.rationale: The presence of a submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration of the overlying mucosa and a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass with fat attenuation on CT is most consistent with a gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST), especially given the lack of malignant features on biopsy which might have suggested gastric adenocarcinoma, and the absence of typical peptic ulcer disease or lipoma characteristics.

rejected.label: Peptic ulcer disease
rejected.why: Lack of typical peptic ulcer disease presentation and absence of Helicobacter pylori or NSAID use history

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: The presence of ulceration and fat attenuation within a heterogeneous mass is not typical for a lipoma

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Biopsy showed no malignant features, which is not consistent with gastric adenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Dieulafoy's lesion
rejected.why: Dieulafoy's lesion typically presents as a small, bleeding mucosal defect without a significant mass, which does not match the described submucosal lesion and mass
